_comment: Source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology (event-contract.md; the draft manifest in kart-platform/docs/services/kart-delivery-tracking-service/message-bus-manifest.json only sketched the ShipmentDispatched consumer queue - this file completes it with this service's own publishing topology). Nothing here is hardcoded in C# - RabbitMqTopologyProvisioner declares every exchange/queue/binding/DLQ/retry-tier straight from this file at startup, exactly like kart-inventory-service/kart-category-service/kart-identity-service. DeliveryStatusUpdated/CarrierStatusIngested/UnmappedCarrierStatusFlagged are all published via this service's own Mongo-backed transactional outbox (OutboxRelayHostedService), which retries indefinitely until RabbitMQ is reachable rather than dead-lettering - so, per the same convention kart-inventory-service's manifest already uses, published events appear only in publishedEvents, never with a DLQ of their own. tracking.carrier-status-ingested.queue is this service's own internal async processing pipeline for the event it publishes to itself (design-decisions.md's 'Durable Ingestion Buffering Pattern') - a self-consumed event, distinct from the externally-consumed tracking.shipping-events.queue.
